user_feedback_nov_03: Honey pouring audio does not match or sound like what is shown; motion-energy alignment is insufficient.
root_cause: Source effects were AI-generated short drizzle (Sonilo and BudgetPixel) stretched by Rubber Band and amplitude-matched to optical flow. They are not authentic per-contact synchronized recordings and apparently do not perceptually resemble honey in the user's shot.
rollback_recommendation: Do not use v4 (or earlier v2/v3) audio. Keep picture and first scene, replace scene 2 and 3 Foley from new appropriate real-source audio and verify perceptual fit.
